$comment: Cross-language wire fixture for the MCP server list the control plane sends the vm-agent
(POST /workspaces/:id/agent-sessions and .../start). Both sides consume THIS file (rule 23):
`mcpServers`, and packages/vm-agent/internal/server/mcp_servers_wire_test.go posts it to the real
create-agent-session handler and asserts every field arrives.
Optional fields appear only when set, so an entry without them is byte-identical to what an
older control plane sent: no `headers` key on a server without custom headers.
